title: ConsistencyAI: A Benchmark to Assess LLMs' Factual Consistency When Responding to Different Demographic Groups
abstract: arXiv:2510.13852v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Is an LLM telling you different facts than it's telling me? This paper introduces ConsistencyAI, an independent benchmark for measuring the factual consistency of large language models (LLMs) for different personas. ConsistencyAI tests whether, when users of different demographics ask identical questions, the model responds with factually inconsistent answers. Designed without involvement from LLM providers, this benchmark offers impartial evaluation and accountability. In our experiment, we queried 19 LLMs with prompts that requested 5 facts for each of 15 topics. We repeated this query 100 times for each LLM, each time adding prompt context from a different persona selected from a subset of personas modeling the general population. We processed the responses into sentence embeddings, computed cross-persona cosine similarity, and computed the weighted average of cross-persona cosine similarity to calculate factual consistency

translated_title: ConsistencyAI：一个评估大语言模型在回应不同人口群体时事实一致性的基准
translated_abstract: 大语言模型告诉你的事实与告诉我的事实不同吗？本文介绍了ConsistencyAI，一个独立的大语言模型（LLM）对不同角色人物的事实一致性测量基准。ConsistencyAI测试当不同人口特征的用户提出相同问题时，模型是否会给出事实不一致的回答。该基准在设计过程中没有LLM提供商的参与，提供了公正的评估和问责机制。在实验中，我们查询了19个大语言模型，提示词要求为15个主题中的每一个提供5个事实。我们对每个LLM重复此查询100次，每次添加来自不同角色的提示上下文，这些角色选自模拟总体人群的角色子集。我们将回答处理成句子嵌入，计算跨角色的余弦相似度，并计算跨角色余弦相似度的加权平均值以得出事实一致性得分。
tldr: 该论文提出了ConsistencyAI——一个独立、公正的基准，通过对19个LLM在不同人口角色下重复查询的实验，量化评估模型面对不同人群提出相同问题时是否存在事实不一致的回答。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ConsistencyAI, an independent and impartial benchmark that quantifies the factual consistency of 19 LLMs when responding to identical questions from users of different demographic personas, using repeated queries and cross-persona cosine similarity analysis.
